document_type: preregistered OFFLINE reference/oracle-label protocol (M3-D task Sec. 7-12, 43); locked BEFORE any characterization run; oracle outputs permanently barred from the online controller (Sec. 13)

reference_protocol_locked.note_delta: identical constant to frozen delta_theta_main; NOT retuned anywhere in M3-D
reference_protocol_locked.arm_covariances: Sigma_k = s_k^2 * exp(-/+0.20) I on the SELECTED component only; all other components untouched
reference_protocol_locked.reference_mode: stochastic matched-CRN Monte Carlo (default preregistered route)
reference_protocol_locked.crn_rule: within a state the three arms share one generator stream with identical component structure/order so rng.choice and standard_normal sequences match and only the selected-component Cholesky scaling differs (same discipline as M3-v0 counterfactual protocol)
reference_protocol_locked.reference_rng_rule: np.random.default_rng([701001 + lexicographic_state_index]) drawn fresh per state, shared by the three arms of that state
reference_protocol_locked.uncertainty_estimator: batched standard error: each arm split into 20 equal sub-batches, SE from batch means; paired contrasts use SE of per-batch differences
reference_protocol_locked.support_requirement: every contrast REQUIRED by the label decision must satisfy |contrast| >= 2 * SE_paired(contrast); failing any requirement marks the state REFERENCE_AMBIGUOUS and INELIGIBLE (no replacement)

oracle_label_rule_locked.HOLD: neither perturbation improves base by more than tau (relative)
oracle_label_rule_locked.ambiguity_precedence: support failures above override any tentative label -> REFERENCE_AMBIGUOUS

direction_margin_gate_locked.Delta_dir_definition: (M2(second_best) - M2(best)) / M2(best) computed over the TWO PERTURBATION ARMS {WIDEN, SHRINK}; best = argmin = labeled action for WIDEN/SHRINK states (operationalization fixed before any data was seen)
direction_margin_gate_locked.failure_action: state excluded from that class (cannot be relabeled)

sign_diversity_gate_locked.distribution_rule: eligible states spread across MULTIPLE frozen configs; single-config monoculture fails the gate
sign_diversity_gate_locked.failure_action: STOP before adaptive trials; redesign requires preregistration amendment (task Sec. 10)

headline_benchmark_selection_locked.ordering_within_class: sort eligible states by (config_id, s2) ascending; take FIRST 8; no adaptive-result-driven substitution

amendment_policy_locked: any change requires docs/phase_m3d/M3_D_PREREG_AMENDMENT_<date>.md committed before further runs
